source: Curated by hand from each site's own account settings pages; checked 2026-11-12. Used before the well-known change-password URL. Sites whose page we are not sure of are left out on purpose: they get https://<origin>/.well-known/change-password instead.

sources.google.com: Google Account > Security > Password (Google Account Help).
sources.github.com: GitHub Docs, 'Changing your password': Settings > Password and authentication.
sources.live.com: Microsoft Support, 'Change your Microsoft account password'.
sources.microsoft.com: Microsoft Support, 'Change your Microsoft account password'.
sources.outlook.com: Outlook.com sign-ins are Microsoft accounts (Microsoft Support).
sources.hotmail.com: Hotmail sign-ins are Microsoft accounts (Microsoft Support).
sources.apple.com: Apple Support, 'Change your Apple Account password': account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security.
sources.icloud.com: iCloud uses the Apple Account (Apple Support).
sources.facebook.com: Meta Accounts Center > Password and security (Facebook Help Center).
sources.instagram.com: Meta Accounts Center > Password and security (Instagram Help Center).
sources.x.com: X Help Center, 'How to change your password': Settings > Your account > Change your password.
sources.twitter.com: twitter.com now redirects to x.com (X Help Center).
sources.linkedin.com: LinkedIn Help, 'Change your password': Settings > Sign in & security.
sources.yahoo.com: Yahoo Help, 'Change your Yahoo password': Account Info > Account Security.
sources.dropbox.com: Dropbox Help, 'Change your password': Settings > Security.
sources.netflix.com: Netflix Help Center, 'How to change or reset your password'.
sources.spotify.com: Spotify Support, 'Change password': Account overview > Change password.
sources.paypal.com: PayPal Help Center, 'How do I change my password?': Settings > Security.
sources.gitlab.com: GitLab Docs, 'User passwords': Edit profile > Password.
sources.adobe.com: Adobe Help, 'Change your Adobe account password': account.adobe.com > Security.
